name: mirage
text: Parlay maker, what the data says (today's journal): only 1% of the ~60 parlay requests a second are ones we can price. Biggest reason: two legs in the same game (44% of what we skip), then legs we have no fair line for (28%), then fair odds over 5 min old. The market pays only +0.64 points over our fair on average, so a 2% margin would win about 41% of the trades we can price. Live so far: 12 quotes, 0 won, 2 parlays settled and both lost (-$6.19), which is too few to call it a losing system. I did NOT loosen live-money limits (the evidence rule needs 200+ priced trades; we have 17). I'm building same-game pricing next, in SHADOW first (logs what it would quote, no money), then the fair-age rule. v1.0.140 (grading fix for bets like UTA +11.5, profit back to your winnings-minus-cost) is building now.
